summary: Small, correctly-scoped streaming fix: when a reasoning parser confirms reasoning-end via the engine (surfacing the trailing text only as content token ids, not as streamed content) and a text-based tool parser follows, the post-marker text (e.g. the leading '<' of '<tool_call>') was dropped, so a tool call batched together with '</think>' leaked into content instead of being parsed. The change recovers that text by decoding the content token ids when no content text is present, and adds a focused regression test that fails without it. The fix is guarded so the common text-based reasoning path is unaffected.

findings.detail: The recovery block lives in the branch taken when the delegating parser is not fully engine-based. That branch is shared: it also runs for purely text-based reasoning parsers, whose reasoning delta already carries the post-marker text as content. The comment mentions only engine reasoning parsers, which may momentarily mislead a maintainer into thinking this code only runs for the engine case. The guard `if not current_text and current_token_ids` makes it a no-op for text parsers (they populate current_text), so behavior is correct; only the comment is narrower than the code path.
findings.suggested_fix: Broaden the comment to note the block is guarded and only fires when reasoning-end was confirmed without emitting the following text as content (i.e. an engine-confirmed end paired with a text-based tool parser), so it is a no-op for text-based reasoning parsers.

findings.detail: Recovery decodes the content-only subset of token ids (extract_content_ids of the delta) back to text. If a single token ever straddles the reasoning-end marker and the following content (boundary not token-aligned), the decoded substring could differ slightly from the true trailing text (leading-space or partial-glyph artifacts). This is inherent to token-granular content extraction and matches how the fully-engine-based path already reconstructs content, so it is not a new defect; noting it for awareness only. Not reproduced with a concrete failing input.
